clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is blocked in this environment. Select and copy the key manually.
confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete provider "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
resetUsageSuccessDesc: Provider "{name}" total usage has been reset
viewFullKeyDesc: Please keep it safe and don't share it with others
healthTestCostHint: Estimated upstream probe cost (not user billing). Global daily budget is editable at the top of this page; over budget disables all scheduled probes until local midnight.
healthTestBudgetHint: Global health-test spend hit the daily cap; all scheduled probes paused until local midnight, or raise the cap to resume.
healthTestBudgetHelp: Fleet health-test spend / global daily cap. The per-provider daily cap below applies to every provider (cards show cost/limit read-only). Over global cap pauses all scheduled probes; over per-provider cap pauses only that provider.
healthTestBudgetEditDesc: Display-currency units (default 1). Saving applies immediately and clears today’s budget pause.
raceModeSingleHelp: Send to one health-preferred provider only; no concurrent race. Single mode disables first-byte timeout (auto 0).
raceModeTimeoutHelp: Primary first; if no first byte by the threshold, launch a health-SLO alternate without cancelling primary. Fastest first-byte wins. When no SLO alternate qualifies, continues through the ordinary dispatch order instead of falling back to single.
raceModeDualFastHelp: Each request dual-sends health-SLO top1+top2 and uses the fastest first-byte. If both exceed the first-byte threshold, the next spare is launched (timeout relay). When fewer than 2 qualify, continues through the ordinary dispatch order instead of falling back to single.
raceIdleHelp: Streaming idle timeout: 0 = disabled; >0 = if no new data arrives for N seconds after the first byte, the upstream is considered stuck — abort and switch provider (global, overrides per-provider values).
raceModeSingleThresholdHelp: First-byte threshold: 0 = disabled (single); >0 = enabled, cold start dual-sends (fastest + cheapest), first first-byte wins, rebind to the cheaper one when it returns within the threshold.
raceThresholdNotUsedDual: Dual fast races immediately; threshold not used.
healthScheduleModeDynamicHelp: SLO rebalance per group_tag: keep qualified top1/top2, auto-disable the rest; explore when fewer than 2 qualify.
healthScheduleModeAlwaysOnHelp: No SLO auto-disable; enabled providers keep scheduled probes (still limited by daily budget and group health-test model).
healthTestProviderBudgetEditDesc: Display currency units, default 0.1. 0 disables the per-provider cap (global budget still applies). Over cap disables only this provider scheduled probes; raising the cap can reopen immediately.
healthTestPerProviderBudgetEditDesc: Site-wide, default 0.1. 0 disables the per-provider cap (global fleet budget still applies). Every provider card shows cost / this limit.
healthTestPerProviderBudgetEditHint: Click to edit per-provider daily cap (site-wide)
healthTestProviderBudgetSiteHint: Per-provider daily cap is site-wide — edit at the top of this page
healthRuntimeSloHint: Qualify: online ≥ {online}% and average first byte ≤ {firstByte}s (both conditions required).
